name: Human Nature
overview: Scripture reveals that human nature is fundamentally flawed and deceitful, with the heart described as desperately wicked and beyond human understanding (Jeremiah 17:9). Evil thoughts and sinful actions originate from within the human heart, including acts such as murder, adultery, and false witness (Matthew 15:19; Mark 7:21). Furthermore, God's ways and thoughts are higher and distinct from human ways, underscoring the fallen condition of mankind in contrast to divine holiness (Isaiah 55:8). Even those without the law naturally do what the law requires, showing an innate moral awareness despite humanity's corruption (Romans 2:14).
